prompt.project_info: Create a casual cozy bedroom selfie in natural daylight.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight dark-brown hair, fair rosy complexion, gentle smile and direct eye contact, wearing an opaque soft-pink ribbed short-sleeve lounge top, white relaxed lounge shorts with ruffled hem, and white crew socks.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle medium selfie, comfortably reclining on her side or seated on the bed rather than face-down, one arm extended for the phone, white rumpled bedding, floral pillows, two windows with white blinds, side table with skincare, pink mug, plant and tissues.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight, casual cozy domestic atmosphere, gentle soft background, realistic fabric and skin detail.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-angle smartphone selfie, medium framing, sharp subject with soft background, natural proportions and color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic high-angle medium selfie of an approved adult woman with long straight dark-brown hair, fair rosy complexion, and a gentle smile with direct eye contact. She wears an opaque soft-pink ribbed short-sleeve lounge top, white relaxed lounge shorts with a ruffled hem, and white crew socks. She reclines comfortably on her side or sits on a bed while holding the phone, with white rumpled sheets, floral pillows, two windows with white frames and horizontal blinds, and a side table holding skincare products, a pink mug, a small plant, and tissues. Use natural daylight, soft background focus, casual cozy domestic mood, realistic fabric, skin texture, and true-to-life color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, crop tank, spaghetti straps, exposed midriff, prone rear-facing pose, bent-leg emphasis, sexualized bedroom pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, bedroom, bedding, windows, side table, pink-white palette, and phone framing; replace outfit with equally opaque loungewear. Keep pose comfortable and typography absent.

changes: Replaced cropped spaghetti-strap top and prone bent-leg framing with opaque short-sleeve loungewear and a comfortable side-seated bedroom selfie.
